title: Report documentation areas independently with covered and gap entries
preconditions: Use five changed lines all owned by one implementation Item with no story/persona links; no in-scope design, quality or health facts.

steps.action: Evaluate the coverage report and serialize JSON.
steps.expected_result: Implementation reports five covered lines; stories and personas each report five uncovered lines; design, quality and health remain separate named empty areas with present collections.

steps.action: Read status --json for the same authored fixture.
steps.expected_result: All six named areas and their covered/uncovered collections are exposed under coverage.

expected_result: A gap in one area does not erase the facts for another.
